title: Tocilizumab vs usual care or placebo for 28-day mortality in hospitalised COVID-19
question: In hospitalised adults with COVID-19, does tocilizumab reduce 28-day all-cause mortality versus usual care, standard care, or placebo?

comparator_scope_note: Three findings, separated. (1) SCOPE: the committed comparator (PMID 34228774) pools the IL-6-antagonist CLASS (tocilizumab + sarilumab), a broader PICO than this tocilizumab-only topic. (2) NO valid same-scope STANDALONE comparator exists: a PubMed search for a tocilizumab-only COVID-mortality meta returns IL-6/monoclonal-antibody CLASS meta-analyses, or papers reporting tocilizumab only as a SUBGROUP (tocilizumab-specific mortality RR ~0.95 [0.76-1.19] in placebo-controlled trials; RR ~0.90 [0.83-0.97] in severe-critical subgroups). So, like the three single-pivotal-trial drugs, tocilizumab has no clean like-for-like published comparator to re-judge against. (3) REACH/EXTRACTION: many tocilizumab COVID-mortality RCTs exist, but of the machine-reachable ones only RECOVERY reports clean per-arm 28-day mortality counts (621/2022 vs 729/2094 -> OR 0.83; the largest, ~4116 patients, pooled here). COVACTA gives mortality as a RATE only (19.7% vs 19.4%, no per-arm counts); EMPACTA and the CORIMUNO trials report death-or-ventilation COMPOSITES. So the verifiable-count k is ~1, and a larger tocilizumab meta reaches higher k via rate/composite counts this harness declines. Honest reach gap, blocked by extraction, with no valid same-scope comparator to benchmark against.
evidence_base_caveat: Evidence base incomplete and NOT a field-representative meta-analysis. Only one trial (RECOVERY, PMID 33933206) is pooled for 28-day mortality here, because the other trial abstracts in this corpus did not yield extractable per-arm counts. The comprehensive comparator (WHO REACT, PMID 34228774, JAMA 2021) pools ~27 trials and reports OR 0.86 (0.79-0.95). A post-fix full-text pass this cycle source-verified 28-day mortality counts for five further eligible RCTs (REMDACTA 34609549, COVACTA 33631066, EMPACTA 33332779, BACC Bay 33085857, Salvarani 33472855) -- but they were deliberately NOT pooled: adding those five small/early-era trials WITHOUT the large trials still missing from this corpus (notably REMAP-CAP, not present here) yields a biased 6-of-~27 subset whose pooled OR (0.98, null) is an artifact of partial completion that diverges from the comprehensive comparator. Completing this topic requires a proper search rebuild to the full trial set, not a partial extraction; the verified counts are held pending that.
